title: A Sudden Reunion
next_chapter_hook: Before leaving, Chen Nian slipped Chen Ji a note with four words: 'Heavenly Secrets Eye' — what did these words, which once only existed in the records of the Tianji Record Fragment, truly mean? And what connection did Zhang Shen have with the Heavenly Secrets Eye?

text.content: The night was as dark as ink, the candles in the Scripture Repository swaying in the draft, stretching Chen Ji's shadow long and short. He sat on a meditation cushion in the corner, holding the mysterious note, his brow slightly furrowed. 'Heavenly Secrets Eye' — these four words were like a blunt knife, repeatedly cutting at his nerves. He tucked the note into his sleeve, his gaze falling on the depths of the tower, where bookshelves stood in rows — the sect's storage for low-grade cultivation techniques. Normally at this hour, the servant disciples would have long extinguished their lamps, yet tonight, faint footsteps echoed.

Chen Ji's brow furrowed, his fingers unconsciously touching the Tianji Record Fragment in his sleeve. The footsteps were nearly soundless; had it not been for the keen perception he'd developed through these days of practice, he would never have detected them. He rose quietly, following the direction of the sound, secretly calculating: had Zhang Shen's people moved ahead of schedule, or was this someone else? Between the gaps of the bookshelves, a faint candlelight flickered, and then a slender figure appeared in his vision — a young woman dressed as a servant, tip-toeing among the bookshelves, searching for something.

dialogue.content: "It should be here... it has to be here..."

text.content: The voice was cold yet carried an imperceptible tremor, as if suppressing some intense emotion. Chen Ji's footsteps abruptly stopped, his entire body freezing as if struck by thunder. That voice — even after all these years, even though it had been deliberately lowered — how could he possibly be mistaken? It was his sister, the person he had desperately tried to find through countless sleepless nights! Chen Nian, his sister who had been missing for five years! Chen Ji's breath suddenly quickened, his palms exuding a fine layer of sweat, reason and emotion colliding violently in his chest.

He drew a deep breath, forcing himself to calm down. Five years apart, five years of searching — now she stood before him, yet appearing as a servant. What did this mean? A Holy Sect conspiracy? Forced disguise? Or was there some other secret? Chen Ji slowly stepped back, stepping on a dry branch that emitted a soft crack. The young woman's figure instantly stiffened, her movements halting, her entire being holding her breath like a startled deer. After a moment, a cold yet achingly familiar voice rang out.

dialogue.content: "Who goes there? Curfew is in effect in the Scripture Repository. All unauthorized persons, leave immediately!"

text.content: Chen Ji stepped out slowly from behind the bookshelf, the candlelight illuminating his face — so calm it appeared almost indifferent. His gaze fell upon the servant, his pupils slightly constricting — her features bore a seventy percent resemblance to that little girl from his memory, the one who always wore twin buns and trailed behind him, except now sharpened and grown thinner. The instant Chen Nian recognized the visitor's face, her entire being was struck as if by a heavy blow, the bamboo slip in her hand clattering to the ground, her eyes instantly reddening, her lips trembling violently.

That 'Brother' carried too many complex emotions — disbelief, suppressed longing, and some indescribable fear. Chen Ji looked at her, at this girl who always used to follow behind him, begging him to tell stories, now grown into a beautiful young woman, yet so thin it broke his heart. He wanted to speak, but his throat felt blocked; not a single word could emerge. Five years — he had searched for five years, and now here she stood before him, yet he found his own voice trembling.

Chen Nian abruptly covered her mouth, tears pouring out, yet she quickly wiped them away. She rushed forward but stopped abruptly three feet from Chen Ji, a flash of wariness and struggle flickering in her gaze. She drew a deep breath, her voice extremely low, trembling slightly.

dialogue.content: "You shouldn't have come here to find me. Brother, someone is watching you — a very dangerous person." Her fingers tightly gripped her sleeve, her knuckles white, "I've been undercover for so long, just to pass this message to you. Brother, there's something wrong with the people around you!"

text.content: Chen Ji's heart sank violently, yet his expression remained unmoved. He stepped forward, gently pressing his hand on Chen Nian's trembling shoulder, feeling that thin frame, a sharp pain twisting in his heart. But his voice remained as calm as still water — only those who knew him well could sense what turbulent waves lay beneath that calmness.

dialogue.content: "Niannian, don't be afraid. Tell Brother, who is it?"

choice.prompt: Chen Nian seemed to have something to say, yet hesitated. Chen Ji needed to decide how to handle this sudden reunion.

choices.description: Not rushing to pursue the truth, first soothing Chen Nian's emotions, after all, she was clearly under immense pressure. Letting the sister feel the warmth of home.
choices.visible_reward: Sibling Bond Rapidly Deepens, Chen Nian May Trust You More
choices.risk_hint: If the Enemy Acts First, May Fall Into a Passive Situation

dialogue.content: Tears rolled down Chen Nian's face like broken pearls, and she flung herself into Chen Ji's arms, sobbing softly. "Brother, I missed you so much... they said you were dead, but I didn't believe it, I never believed it..." Her voice was muffled against his chest, carrying all the grievances and longing of five years.

text.content: Chen Ji gently patted her back, while his gaze swept the surroundings, confirming no one was present before speaking quietly. "Niannian, don't cry. Tell Brother, who wants to make a move on you? Why are you here as a servant?" His voice was gentle, yet a cold gleam flickered in his eyes.

choices.description: Time is short; must learn who is behind this as quickly as possible. Directly asking Chen Nian what she has seen and heard during her undercover time.
choices.visible_cost: May Scare Chen Nian, Making Her More Nervous
choices.visible_reward: Quickly Obtain Critical Intelligence, Beneficial for Subsequent Planning
choices.risk_hint: Chen Nian May Omit Important Details Due to Nervousness

dialogue.content: Chen Nian was startled by his direct questioning, a flash of hurt flickering across her features, but she quickly composed herself. She bit her lip and said rapidly: "It's Zhang Shen — he's not an ordinary Inner Disciple, he's an agent of the Heavenly Secrets Eye! Someone is secretly monitoring everything you do!"

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils contracted violently. Heavenly Secrets Eye — that existence occasionally mentioned by Mo Xiansheng but never truly explained. Zhang Shen, actually connected to it? His fingers trembled slightly, yet quickly steadied. He spoke quietly: "Continue."

choices.memory_label: 兄妹重逢，追问情报优先

text.content: Chen Nian's body stiffened slightly; she instinctively retreated half a step, her gaze flickering uncertainly. Her fingers twisted the corner of her garment, her lips moving several times, as if hesitating whether to speak. Finally, she drew a deep breath, her voice lowered even further.

dialogue.content: "Brother, there are some things I can't say here... but you must be careful of Zhang Shen, and also..." She paused, a flash of fear in her eyes, "...and also the Old Patriarch. There's some connection between them — I've overheard their secret discussions, mentioning the Tianji Record, mentioning you."

text.content: A violent storm raged in Chen Ji's heart, yet his expression remained unmoved. Zhang Shen, the Old Patriarch — these two actually had a connection? And the Tianji Record — how did they know about it? He recalled Mo Xiansheng's previous hints: the Tianji Record was one of the pieces placed by Heavenly Will. Could it be that from the very beginning, he had already been marked? Seeing Chen Ji silent, Chen Nian thought he was worried and quickly added.

dialogue.content: "Brother, I barely found this opportunity to infiltrate. You must believe me — the people around you now, not one of them is innocent." Her eyes reddened again, her voice carrying a sob, "I know you don't trust anyone, but... but you must trust me. I'm your sister..."

choice.prompt: Chen Nian looked at Chen Ji with tear-filled eyes, awaiting his response. As someone accustomed to planning alone, how should Chen Ji face this long-lost sister?

choices.description: No matter how many secrets his sister harbors, she is the sole bloodline of the Chen family. In this dog-eat-dog world, family is the only weakness and the only bottom line.
choices.visible_cost: Risk of Exposing Your Own Cards
choices.visible_reward: Gain Sister's Complete Trust, She May Reveal More Holy Sect Secrets
choices.risk_hint: If Chen Nian Has Been Manipulated, May Cause Total Collapse

text.content: Chen Ji was silent for a moment, then suddenly reached out and gently ruffled Chen Nian's hair, just like when they were children. "Silly girl, how could Brother not believe you." His voice was low and tender, "Tell me, does the Holy Sect know you're here?"

dialogue.content: Chen Nian froze, then the tears flowed even more freely. She nodded fiercely, her voice carrying a wail: "They think I'm just an ordinary scout... but I'll be careful, you be careful too, Brother!" Her fingers tightly gripped Chen Ji's sleeve, "I've found out some things, about the Heavenly Secrets Eye, about the origin of the Tianji Record —"

choices.text: Maintain Vigilance, Keep Room for Maneuver
choices.description: Trust Your Sister's Love, But Not Her Judgment. She May Be Used by the Holy Sect Without Knowing; Blind Trust Would Harm Her and Yourself.
choices.visible_reward: Maintain Rational Judgment, Avoid Possible Traps
choices.risk_hint: If Judgment Is Wrong, May Lose an Important Ally

text.content: Chen Ji gently released her, stepping back, his expression complex as he looked at her. "Niannian, over the years... you've suffered." His tone was calm, yet carried an imperceptible distance, "But what you've told me, I need to verify. You know Brother's situation — one misstep, and it's an abyss."

dialogue.content: A dim light flickered in Chen Nian's eyes, yet she quickly nodded in understanding. "I understand... Brother has always been like this." She drew a folded note from her sleeve, pressing it into Chen Ji's hand, "This is the most important thing I've found. Once you see it, you'll understand — what the Heavenly Secrets Eye truly is."

text.content: Chen Ji took the note but did not immediately open it. He looked at Chen Nian, at this little girl reduced to skin and bone, his heart churning with mixed emotions. He suddenly remembered nights from many years ago, when Chen Nian was young and loved to cling to him, begging for stories. He would tell tales of heroes, of justice conquering evil — back when he still believed in such things.

"Brother?" Chen Nian's voice broke his reverie, "What are you thinking?" Chen Ji shook his head, tucking the note into his sleeve. Just as he was about to speak, suddenly — footsteps rang out in the distance. Chen Nian's face changed drastically; she quickly wiped her tears, lowering her voice: "Someone's coming! Brother, I have to go — remember, don't let anyone see what's written on the note!"

dialogue.content: "Niannian—" Chen Ji reached out to grab her, but only caught empty air. Chen Nian's figure vanished between the bookshelves like a ghost, leaving only a faint fragrance and words drifting in the wind. "Brother, be careful of that Mr. Mo beside Zhang Shen... he's not human!"

text.content: Chen Ji froze in place. Mr. Mo? Mo Xiansheng? Chen Nian said Mo Xiansheng was 'not human' — what did that mean? Having dealt with Mo Xiansheng for so long, he had never detected anything abnormal. Was Chen Nian's intelligence wrong, or was there some hidden truth? The footsteps drew closer; he drew a deep breath, quickly adjusted his expression, resuming that wooden, timid demeanor, lowering his head to flip through the bamboo slip in his hands, as if he were merely a servant disciple obsessed with cultivation techniques.

dialogue.content: "Oh? Working hard this late at night?"

text.content: Chen Ji's heart tightened. He raised his eyes to see an elderly figure shuffling in through the door — it was the Old Patriarch of the Tianqing Sect, Ling Yuan. His smile was warm, but his eyes were as cold and sinister as a venomous snake. Chen Ji hastily rose to bow, his voice carrying appropriate fear.

dialogue.content: "Disciple Chen Ji pays respects to the Patriarch. Disciple merely... couldn't sleep, came to browse some techniques..."

"Chen Ji..." Ling Yuan pronounced this name meaningfully, a knowing smile on his face, "I remember you, that stubborn little fellow from back then. These years you've been wronged, staying in the Servants' Quarters for so long." He stepped closer, his gaze scanning over Chen Ji, "I hear you've been quite close with the Inner Disciple Zhang Shen recently?"

text.content: Cold sweat seeped through Chen Ji's spine, yet his face showed only confusion. "Senior Brother Zhang Shen? Disciple... Disciple have merely occasionally asked him a few questions, no deep association..." He lowered his eyes, portraying fear and humility as a废物 should. Ling Yuan stared at him for a moment, then suddenly burst into hearty laughter.

dialogue.content: "Young man, know when to advance and when to retreat. Some things are not for you to meddle with." Ling Yuan patted his shoulder, turning to leave, "Go rest early. The night wind is cold." Footsteps gradually faded; Chen Ji slowly raised his head, a fierce cold light flickering in his gaze. Old thing — was this a warning to him?

text.content: Chen Ji stood in place for a long while, until he confirmed Ling Yuan had truly left, before taking out the note Chen Nian had left from his sleeve. In the swaying candlelight, he slowly unfolded the note — there were only four characters, the ink still glistening, as if carrying a certain诡异 weight: Heavenly Secrets Eye.

Chen Ji stared at these four characters, his heart churning with violent waves. Heavenly Secrets Eye — that existence hinted at by Mo Xiansheng, yet never truly explained. Mo Xiansheng said the Tianji Record was the key pursued by prophets throughout the ages seeking the truth of Heaven's Way; the origin of the Tianji Record was 'Heaven's Will'. Now his sister claimed the Heavenly Secrets Eye was watching him. Was all this coincidence, or a chess game arranged by fate? His fingers trembled slightly as he brought the note closer to the candlelight, watching it turn to ash in the flames.

The note burned away, leaving only a wisp of blue smoke. Chen Ji stood amid the ashes, his gaze deep as an abyss. Tonight's encounter changed many things — his sister's return was an unexpected joy, yet the accompanying warning was like a basin of cold water, splashing over what he thought was a clear chess game. Zhang Shen, Ling Yuan, Heavenly Secrets Eye, Mo Xiansheng — among these people and matters, who was whose chess piece, who was manipulating everything behind the scenes? And what troubled him even more was his sister's words — 'he's not human' — Mo Xiansheng, what secrets was he hiding? The night wind blew through the hall, dispersing the final wisp of smoke. Chen Ji turned and walked slowly out of the Scripture Repository, his silhouette disappearing into the night. The pale light of dawn faintly appeared on the horizon; a new day was about to begin, and his game against fate had only just entered the true deep waters.
